title: Artificial Intelligence and Radiomics in the Diagnosis and Management of Cancer

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Artificial Intelligence and Radiomics in the Diagnosis and Management of Cancer》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Radiomics, which involves the high-throughput assessment of imaging features, aims to transform images into structured phenotypic data.

evidence.text: Radiomics, which involves the high-throughput assessment of imaging features, aims to transform images into structured phenotypic data.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Artificial Intelligence and Radiomics in the Diagnosis and Management of Cancer》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Imaging is increasingly essential for the diagnosis, prognostication, and management of cancer patients.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】By correlating imaging-derived data with clinical and molecular information, radiomics offers the potential to relate tumor biology to imaging phenotype to improve patient prognostication and management.

evidence.text: Imaging is increasingly essential for the diagnosis, prognostication, and management of cancer patients.

By correlating imaging-derived data with clinical and molecular information, radiomics offers the potential to relate tumor biology to imaging phenotype to improve patient prognostication and management.
